newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Investment Bank 1996 net profit up 46 pct.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Investment Bank 1996 net profit up 46 pct.

text.p: The Saudi Investment Bank announced on Saturday a 46 percent increase in its 1996 net profit to 124.6 million riyals ($33.2 million) from 85.1 million in 1995.
The Riyadh-based bank said in a statement loans and advances climbed to 4.09 billion riyals in 1996, up 12 percent from 3.65 billion riyals in 1995.
Customer deposits rose to 7.03 billion riyals from 6.15 billion riyals and assets grew to 9.82 billion riyals from 8.21 billion riyals.

Chairman Abdul-Aziz al-O'hali said the board of directors had recommended a 86.4 million riyal dividend to shareholders for 1996, more than the 1995 net profit. No comparative figures were given for the previous year.
The bank in 1996 increased its paid-up capital to 720 million riyals from 180 million riyals.
It is owned by Saudi investors and several Saudi and foreign banks including Chase Manhattan Corp and Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd.
